mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased corporate costs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE falls below 4% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% MoM signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST MoM growth exceeds 5% and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM decline exceeds 1% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strong economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and PAYEMS both increase MoM
failure_condition: If RSAFS and PAYEMS both increase MoM and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM decline exceeds 100,000 and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 70% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ decline exceeds 0.5% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of the instances.
